verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one product-page line saying users can build agents with chat or a visual builder that 'run proactively based on triggers you set'. That is a first-party workflow-automation capability, but it never says the triggers can be time-based or recurring rather than event-based. Scheduled send timing and MCP-driven workflows run from Claude or ChatGPT are one-off actions, not recurring schedules. Missing for 10: explicit time-based or recurring schedule triggers (e.g., cron-like or daily/weekly runs), documentation of how scheduled workflows are configured and managed, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
